title: Televised broadcast footage of KHON-TV2, Honolulu — off air, 31 January 1990
license: This work is copyright protected and not available for download. Please contact the archive for more information. (ʻUluʻulu, Hawaiʻi state moving-image archive)
notes: USA (Hawaiʻi), English. KHON-TV2 Honolulu recorded off air: the anchor at the world-map desk and the cut out of it, a reporter in the CHANNEL 2 NEWS room, Senator Spark Matsunaga under a chyron, an over-the-shoulder WAIHEE box, Executive Chambers, a State Capitol hearing. Fetched from the archive's public preview asset (uluulu.recollectcms.com/assets/show/1/32123) — the archive serves 5:11 of the 4:07:51 tape, so the advert pods and the clock in the scout's note are not reachable. Pre-cropped to remove the ʻuluʻulu watermark; the modern copyright card at 0-11 s is excluded.
